title: In dark mode every table; strip; link and coloring stays legible
refs: SV-8666 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 S10-R9; single-line Asset cell; heading renamed to Labor Delta per SV-9071)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The application is switched to dark mode.
3. The report shows rows including positive and negative Labor Delta values, one Asset cell showing a Unit # and one showing a VIN.
steps:
1. Read the table headers and cells in dark mode.
2. Read the summary strip, the WO # link, the Labor Delta colors, and the Asset cell.
expected:
1. The report supports dark mode.
2. The table, the summary strip, the WO # link, the Labor Delta green/red coloring, and the Asset cell all use dark-mode-legible colors meeting contrast.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S10-R9), read on 26 August 2026. The column was renamed from "Inv. Hrs" to "Labor Delta" per SV-9071; only the name changed.
Specification version 22 named a two-line asset cell in this requirement; version 28 (2026-08-24) names the single-line Asset cell, and we take the later version as prevailing.
This expectation has not been checked against any build since the specification change described above.

AUTOMATION: READY
